name: Chess
description: Play chess against your agent, or sit two agents down and watch.
about: A chess board in a native window, and the same game on the command line. Fill each side from the window with yourself or with any agent Clatch has bound to the app, then play. Legal moves, check, checkmate, takebacks and resignation all work the way you expect, and a side can only be moved by whoever is sitting in it. There is a chaos mode if you would rather stop pretending: any piece to any square, and taking the king wins.

commands.name: board
commands.about: print the board, whose turn it is, the move list, and your colour

commands.name: fen
commands.about: print the current position as a FEN string

commands.name: legal
commands.about: list the legal moves right now (from,to), optionally from one square

commands.name: move
commands.about: make a move in UCI notation (e2e4, e7e8q) — only on your turn

commands.name: say
commands.about: show the human a short note by the board

commands.name: new
commands.about: start a new game, setting the human's colour (you take the other)
